# authwise_domains (Data Source)

A domain the tenant serves logins on. The id is the domain name itself. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) Every domain under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String)
- `domain_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
